messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — embeddings-route experiencing sustained high QPS and elevated 503s. Auto-escalation: paging maya and liam. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/embeds-hot

maya: I'm paged, looking. seeing a steady spike from tenant 'acme-inc' + a few noisy dev keys. Latency up, tail tokens queueing.

liam: I see it too. QPS jumped ~10x at 18:12 UTC. Worker spinups not keeping up, KV cache miss rate climbed. Possible client loop?

maya: Initial mitigation plan: (A) soft-shed embeddings QPS per-route for public tier to 600 qps (B) temporarily disable rerank on public routes for 15m (C) carve dedicated slot for enterprise tenants if needed. Doing (A) now.

maya: Running command:```/opt/rwctl/quota set --route embeddings-public --qps 600 --mode soft --duration 30m --note "auto-mitigation from page"```

ops-robot: quota update applied -> embeddings-public qps soft cap 600 (effective immediately).

liam: Pushing rerank toggle:```/opt/rwctl/feature toggle --name rerank-public --state off --reason "reduce downstream load"```

devx-sre: heads up — disabling rerank will increase some customers' latency but should cut extra backend work. CS notified?

customer-support: Notifying top 5 affected tenants (acme-inc, beta-shop, datawave) with status note and ETA 30m. We'll escalate to account owners for enterprise tenants.

maya: 90s after soft-shed: tail latency down ~40%, 503s reduced from ~6% -> 1.2%. QPS for embeddings route now stable at ~580. Rerank disable cut backend load another ~15%.

liam: Still seeing one noisy API key making repeated calls — adding temporary per-key throttle for that key:```/opt/rwctl/key throttle set --key k_acme_spike --qps 80 --duration 60m```

ops-robot: key throttle applied -> k_acme_spike qps 80.

maya: Metrics look good. Plan to leave soft cap and key throttle in place and continue 30m observation. If errors stay <1.5% we'll start phased rollback: re-enable rerank for enterprise only, then revisit public cap.

liam: Adding monitoring alerts: high_error_rate if embeddings 5m error_rate >2% AND qps >700 -> page oncall.

maya: Handoff time — @ash next oncall in 10m. Notes for handoff: what we changed (soft cap embeddings-public 600, rerank-public OFF, key throttle k_acme_spike 80), current metrics (errors 1.2%, qps 570), tenant impacts (degraded throughput for heavy public tenants, enterprise unaffected), links to dashboards and commands used.

ash: ack taking over. I'll monitor for 45m, will escalate to eng-infra if error_rate creeps >2% or if we see secondary hotspots. If stable after 45m, I'll start controlled re-enable of rerank for enterprise then public in that order.

maya: Thanks. CS - keep customer comms open. If any customer reports production impact beyond rate-limited behavior, tag oncall immediately. :thumbsup:

customer-support: Will update tickets and post a follow-up message to affected tenants when we re-enable features.

devx-sre: Postmortem note: cause appears to be a runaway client loop + insufficient hard quotas on public embeddings route. Action items: 1) add per-key default soft quotas for public tier, 2) add automated noisy-key detection and auto-throttle, 3) run chaos test on rerank toggle path.

maya: Closing page for now. If anything changes, reopen thread.
